detailed_description:
The target video is original 2004 PlayStation 2 open-world gameplay footage with angular low-poly characters, flat painted textures, simple diffuse shading and warm hazy light, framed as vertical 9:16. Every person shares the same painted PS2 character style.
[Shot 1] A third-person camera follows behind and slightly above <Subject 2>, the woman with the long black ponytail, maroon sleeveless top, maroon leggings and white trainers, as she walks straight along the warm-grey pavement of <Subject 6>, away from the camera, at an easy steady pace. She carries <Subject 3>, the black handbag with the gold clasp, by its top handle in her left hand, and it swings slightly with each step. The covered walkway with grey pillars runs along the left, the road with double yellow lines runs along the right, and rain trees and HDB blocks line the distance. <Subject 8>, the commuter in the light-blue shirt and khaki trousers, walks toward the camera on the right side of the pavement, passes the girl on her right and leaves the frame past the camera on the right. Next, <Subject 9>, the passer-by in the yellow cap and yellow polo, steps out from under the covered walkway on the left and crosses the pavement from left to right between the camera and the girl, hiding her for a moment. He reaches the kerb on the right and stands there facing down the road. The girl reappears with the same ponytail, maroon outfit, white trainers and the same black handbag in her left hand, keeps walking, slows and stops with both feet on the round yellow marker painted on the pavement, and stands still. The camera keeps the same distance, height and heading behind her throughout, moving forward with her and coming to rest as she stops, with the horizon level. Each person's feet stay on the pavement and each casts a soft shadow from the high afternoon sun. These three people are the only people in view, and every surface keeps the painted PS2 look of <Subject 1>.
